title: Repeal of subsections.
bodyText: Any subsection of section 26H-2 may be repealed or amended and such action shall not affect other provisions or applications of this chapter.
bodyHtml: §26H‑7  Repeal of subsections.  Any subsection of section 26H‑2 may be repealed or amended and such action shall not affect other provisions or applications of this chapter. [L 1977, c 70, pt of §2]
